Devices/links/interfaces/observations read from the returned NetworkModel; routes/vlans/acls from the same model. Engine states read from out.adapter_results[].report. engine_c was UNAVAILABLE on every level ('pt-convert checkout missing src/lib/packet-crypto.ts'). diagnose() returned only CONFIRMED_DEFECT hypotheses on all six levels; no SUSPECTED or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE hypothesis was emitted, so 'inconclusive' is empty everywhere by observation, not by choice.
